text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Champions Cup. As Smart 
Falcon gives her all in the Winning Live, 
the fans cheer wildly for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the faces of each and every
one of her devoted fans, Smart Falcon 
reaffirmed her own sparkle and made a
full 
comeback from rock bottom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To support her after she regained her 
stride,
the Trainer makes a proposal after 
the live performance. And that proposal 
is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A "Christmas Handshake Event." Before her 
final goal, the Tokyo Daishoten, she 
decided to spend time interacting with
her 
fans.
